comparison.objective: Batch-transfer five fragile upright tiles into a box efficiently; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object grasping and fragile upright transport versus tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Scores trip count only if every tile remains upright and contained; candidate scores physical unlocking, tuning, relocking and repeatable safe carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Shared care and bimanual handling are generic; the tested abilities are materially different.
